title: Analogy — Match the relationship
question: How do two pairs of words belong together?
audience: Grade 7 students studying Quarter 1 Module 1; everyday English words are familiar but analogy notation may be new.
promise: I can name the relationship in the first word pair and check that the second pair follows it in the same order.

look.mood: LingoQuest navy stage with cream lettering, blue relationship brackets, green matching links and small gold emphasis. Legible flat educational diagrams; no decorative 3D or fast motion.

voice.name: Kokoro Michael — existing module narrator
voice.note: Uses the owner’s existing all-module Kokoro preference. One continuous take, not clips per sentence. Tutorial ElevenLabs recordings are untouched.

music.track: Original quiet instrumental bed, composed after storyboard approval
music.note: Quiet bed under narration; key relationship changes receive soft cues. No abrupt loop and no copyrighted library audio.

facts.claim: Word analogies compare the relationships between two word pairs; the second pair must preserve the first pair’s relationship.
facts.source: CO_Q1_ENGLISH 7_Module 1 — Analogy; supplied Drive PDF 1apMCFoA_8wiK--6IjOwDJ_3q8WIv8UX8; SHA256 90d3d6aa4700af691bdb952c37c12918515f57c39ecc4e351c68839e8d13499d. PDF page 10 (printed page 7).

acts.title: The question
acts.goal: See two complete pairs and ask what makes their relationships fit.

acts.title: Read the pattern
acts.goal: Connect opposite meanings and decode the colon notation aloud.

acts.title: Follow the connection
acts.goal: Use the part-to-whole example to match both meaning and order.

acts.title: Other patterns
acts.goal: Name the remaining relationships without inventing new examples.

acts.title: The takeaway
acts.goal: Name the first relationship and check the second in the same direction.

scope: Sample of the word-relationship discussion. The module’s literary analogy/simile/metaphor extension remains in the lesson; this short does not claim to replace the complete module. No scored items, answers, game mechanics, timers or progress requirements change.
accessibility: Optional click-to-play video, no autoplay; English WebVTT captions and selectable transcript; static labeled fallback.
integration: Only module g7-q1-m1: add Watch & Understand video card within Illustrated Examples, preserving the existing visual guide and narration. Preview only; no main merge.
